welcome_page.title: Public transport – Comfort
welcome_page.description:
Crowding, timetables, delays, waiting and your surroundings when you use public transport.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: How do you feel being close to other people on board or at the stop?

options.text: Very uncomfortable
A little uncomfortable
It doesn't bother me
Mostly comfortable
Very comfortable

questions.text: How well do the timetable and frequency on your routes fit your needs?

options.text: Not at all: it's too rare or unreliable
Only for some regular trips (e.g. work or school)
For planned trips, but not at short notice
Well, but I plan around the timetable
Very well: it's so frequent I don't need to plan

questions.text: How stressful are unexpected delays or cancellations for you?

options.text: Not stressful at all
Slightly stressful
Moderately stressful
Very stressful
Extremely stressful

questions.text: When the service is late or unreliable, what do you do?

options.text: I leave earlier, just in case
I change route or travel time
I don't rely on it for important trips
I use another way of travelling instead
I have no alternative: I wait, sometimes for a long time
I arrive late for work, school or appointments
I give up the trip
It doesn't change what I do

questions.text: How do you feel about being seen using public transport?

options.text: I'd rather not be seen using it
I sometimes feel uncomfortable in certain situations
Now and then I feel out of place
It has nothing to do with my image
I feel comfortable and confident using it

questions.text: On hot days, are waits at stops without shade hard for you?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Do you need a seat at the stop or on board, and often find none?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Do unclear or missing signs at stops and stations make it hard to find your way?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: When you use public transport, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly
Moderately
Very
Extremely

questions.text: When you use public transport, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: Nothing, it doesn't affect me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or closed windows
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)

questions.text: When you use public transport, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you use public transport, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: It doesn't affect me
I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you use public transport, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
Sometimes they affect my mood
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

it.#How do you feel being close to other pe: Come ti senti a stare vicino ad altre persone a bordo o alla fermata?
it.#Mostly comfortable: Per lo più a mio agio
it.#How well do the timetable and frequency: Quanto l'orario e la frequenza sul tuo percorso rispondono alle tue esigenze?

it.#Very well: it's so frequent I don't nee: Molto bene: passa così spesso che non devo organizzarmi
it.#How stressful are unexpected delays or: Quanto ti stressano ritardi o cancellazioni inattesi?
it.#When the service is late or unreliable,: Quando il servizio è in ritardo o poco affidabile, cosa fai?
it.#I don't rely on it for important trips: Non ci faccio affidamento per gli spostamenti importanti
it.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Non ho alternative: aspetto, anche a lungo
it.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: Arrivo in ritardo al lavoro, a scuola o agli appuntamenti
it.#How do you feel about being seen using: Come ti senti a essere visto mentre usi i mezzi pubblici?
it.#I'd rather not be seen using it: Preferirei non essere visto mentre li uso
it.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable in certa: A volte mi sento a disagio in certe situazioni
it.#Now and then I feel out of place: Ogni tanto mi sento fuori posto
it.#It has nothing to do with my image: Non c'entra niente con la mia immagine
it.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Mi sento a mio agio e sicuro nell'usarli
it.#On hot days, are waits at stops without: Nelle giornate calde, l’attesa alle fermate senza ombra è difficile per te?
it.#Do you need a seat at the stop or on bo: Hai bisogno di sederti alla fermata o a bordo e spesso non trovi posto?
it.#Do unclear or missing signs at stops an: Indicazioni poco chiare o assenti alle fermate e nelle stazioni ti rendono difficile orientarti?
it.#Your surroundings: Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#When you use public transport, how much: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, quanto ti disturba o ti infastidisce il rumore del traffico?
it.#When you use public transport, what do: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina o i finestrini chiusi
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che a piedi)
it.#When you use public transport, what do: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#When you use public transport, what do: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#When you use public transport, do pleas: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale.
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Crowding, timetables, delays, waitin:
Affollamento, orari, ritardi, attese e ambiente intorno a te quando usi i mezzi pubblici.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
